WITH stage_0 AS (
  SELECT class_uid, message, "metadata.log_source", "metadata.uid", "process.name", time FROM __nano_lake_source__
  WHERE time >= '2026-09-24 07:00:00.000000' AND time < '2026-09-25 07:01:00.000000'
  AND (((class_uid = 1007) AND lower("metadata.log_source") != 'audit'))
),
stage_1 AS (
  SELECT "process.name" AS "process.name", count() AS c
  FROM stage_0
  GROUP BY "process.name"
),
stage_2 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_1
  ORDER BY c DESC, "process.name" ASC
),
stage_3 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_2
  LIMIT 20
),
__nano_stats_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, count() OVER () AS __nano_stats_total, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c DESC, "process.name" ASC ) AS __nano_stats_ordinal FROM stage_3
)
SELECT * FROM __nano_stats_ranked WHERE __nano_stats_ordinal = 1 OR (__nano_stats_ordinal > 0 AND __nano_stats_ordinal <= 501) ORDER BY __nano_stats_ordinal LIMIT 501 SETTINGS max_threads=16, max_execution_time=300, optimize_read_in_order=0, optimize_aggregation_in_order=0
